affected.note: Confirmed leaked personal data from insurance and mutual-aid claim investigations entrusted to the company: about 89,000 records with case or policy numbers only, about 12,500 with numbers plus name and other details, and about 1,200 that also contained medical information. A further about 1,030 investigation records, about 450 contractor and applicant records and about 150 employee records may have leaked. Counts may include duplicates. Attackers entered through a vulnerable network device and disabled security software.

summary.en: Insurance claims investigation firm Shinchosha was hit by a ransomware attack on 2025-06-27 that encrypted and stole files from its servers and PCs. Its final report said about 102,700 personal records from entrusted investigations had leaked, including about 1,200 with medical information.
summary.ja: 保険事故調査を手がける審調社は2025年6月27日、ランサムウェア攻撃を受け、サーバーや端末のファイルが暗号化・窃取された。最終報で、委託調査に関する個人情報約10万2,700件の漏えいを確認し、うち約1,200件には医療情報が含まれていたと公表した。
